_law: Model DNA — the raw temperament of each engine, turned into a personality ATTRIBUTE. A host is a PRINT (the soul, lab/cast) layered on a MODEL (the temperament). We never let the model BE the personality; the print drives it and the actor-loop takes one turn at a time. Context window is itself a trait: tiny = reactive/impulsive (can't hold the thread), huge = well-briefed/measured. Tested live via OpenRouter 2026-09-01.
internet_law: NO LLM has native internet. Live/impartial context comes from the RESEARCH node (see research_engines): Perplexity Sonar has native web, or a tools:yes model can call a web tool. Any host can be 'informed' - we FEED it context; the model's context_tokens caps how much it can hold. This is why context window matters when a host (or a user) must reason over a large briefing.

casting_rule: Match the model's quirk to the seat whose personality NEEDS it. A show is a spread of temperaments: pair a fast gut (Flash Lite) against a slow analyst (R1), drop the uncensored comic (Hermes-4) in for the button, let the wildcard (Weaver) detonate one line. Diversity of engines = diversity of voices, for pennies.
